title: Adding files and folders
intro: Upload files from your computer, or drag them onto the file list. New files land in the folder you have open.

sections.heading: Upload files or a folder
steps: Choose **Upload files** to add one or more files.
Choose **Upload folder** to add a whole folder, with everything inside it.

sections.heading: Create a new file or folder
steps: Choose **New folder** to make a folder.
Choose **New Markdown file** for notes with headings and lists.
Choose **New Text file** for plain text.
sections.tip: Type a name and click **OK**. A new file opens straight away, ready to type into.
sections.note: If your company has turned on editing in the browser, the menu also offers **New Word document** and **New Excel spreadsheet**. In a library shared with you as read-only, **Upload** is hidden and **Create** offers only **New library**. Ask the owner for Read-Write access.
